chunks: Do not turn away those who supplicate their Lord morning and evening, seeking His magnificence. You are not accountable for them in the least, nor they for you at all. If you drive them away you will be unjust.
ai.seo_question: Why should leaders not expel the poor worshippers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (6:52) is often cited to validate the spiritual authority of the Ahl al-Bayt and early companions regardless of their material wealth, emphasizing that divine favor is not contingent on social status. It underscores the principle that leaders are not responsible for the sincerity of the worshippers' devotion, nor are the worshippers responsible for the leaders' administrative decisions, thereby protecting the community from elitist exclusion.
